content: The issue of the trade replay, which inaccurately reports 'REPL' instead of 'NEWM' to TRAX on our active, unarchived trades caused by the RH archiving story 2323911, adversely affects the changes made for the #13 fix. The revamped ESP extract for #13 issues replay messages for re-booked trades, which are updated with the original Position Trader information derived from OMS trade linkages. Since all replay messages have <SST_REPLAY> = 'Y', RH will report them as 'REPL' to TRAX. However, TRAX will reject all #13 replay messages as they had never previously been reported. In summary, the replayed trade messages from #13 will follow the same fate as other BAU replay messages and be universally rejected. This means that all changes in relation to #13 from ESP and RH are rendered ineffective.
